what: The settings' Open the script and Voice Pilot's hook editor, in a dev bb 0.50.1 started with a throwaway HOME holding only ~/.config/voice-pilot/hook.sh (mode 755); the owner's own hook folder was never read or written.
openedOn: /plugins/voice-pilot/voice, in bb's file panel, tab hook.sh, editor header "~/.config/voice-pilot/hook.sh on MacMini"

save.notice: Saved on MacMini. It is still executable.

conflict.how: a line appended to the file on disk after it was loaded, then an edit saved
conflict.warning: The file changed on disk since it was loaded. Reload to see what is there now (your edits here are lost), or Save anyway to replace it with your version.

offline.how: the dev bb's host daemon stopped with SIGSTOP (and resumed with SIGCONT afterwards), then an edit saved
offline.notice: Could not reach MacMini: it may be offline, or bb's host daemon there is not running. (the machine did not answer within 10 s)

earlier: Before the editor (commit 74e81aa), the same hook.sh opened in bb's File Editor (monaco-editor), which showed "This file has no environment to resolve it against": bb 0.50.1's File Editor resolves a host file only through an environment, and a plugin's host target has none.
